# CGRX v0.1.0-alpha.13

This alpha adds an interactive repository atlas and speeds up graph analysis without changing the evidence shown by the API.

- Replaces the previous web explorer with a React workspace inspired by Clew, with 2D and 3D views, symbol inspection, Git history, and file or package overviews.
- Shows proven symbol calls and implementations as individual connections. Large graphs have explicit node and edge limits and coverage indicators.
- Lists local Git projects, lets you search and switch between them, and keeps each project's graph, source and history isolated. Indexes are loaded on demand.
- Moves large D3 layouts into a cancellable browser worker. Switching projects and searching remain responsive while positions are calculated.
- Speeds up runtime startup by interning similarity fingerprints and replacing quadratic dynamic-gap containment checks with a sorted sweep. On the pinned benchmark, median startup fell from 1072 ms to 417 ms; graph responses remained byte-identical.
- Includes a [performance review](https://github.com/ibotpafos/cgrx/blob/v0.1.0-alpha.13/docs/performance-review-2026-09-22.md) with measurements, proof limits and remaining bottlenecks.

The downloadable Apple Silicon archive includes the web assets and `SHA256SUMS`. Linux and Intel macOS remain pinned source-install paths with Rust 1.89.0.
